message.abstract:
<jats:p>
                    This paper describes an efficient algorithm to determine whether an arbitrary graph
                    <jats:italic>G</jats:italic>
                    can be embedded in the plane. The algorithm may be viewed as an iterative version of a method originally proposed by Auslander and Parter and correctly formulated by Goldstein. The algorithm used depth-first search and has
                    <jats:italic>O</jats:italic>
                    (
                    <jats:italic>V</jats:italic>
                    ) time and space bounds, where
                    <jats:italic>V</jats:italic>
                    is the number of vertices in
                    <jats:italic>G</jats:italic>
                    . An ALGOL implementation of the algorithm succesfully tested graphs with as many as 900 vertices in less than 12 seconds.
                  </jats:p>
title: Efficient Planarity Testing
